name: L6 calibrated target adaptation of cross-species temporal initialization
status: Prospectively fixed AFTER L5 pilot outcomes, before any L6 human fit; exploratory on an already examined participant
question: Does macaque initialization improve same-architecture target adaptation beyond target-only initialization and strong ridge references?
prior_information: L5 H1 forward primary real .132208, synthetic .106048, random .123506 and raw full-history ridge10 .160240 already inspected. Original minival scores invalid as held-out data. This follow-up is not fresh confirmatory human evidence.

data.outputs: Seven instructed open-loop velocity axes, not measured movements

split.support: First three whole trials containing eligible rows; ALL eval_mask True rows, including rest
split.query: Identical to L5 k3_all: eligible rows in every whole trial after three; never used for normalization, gradients, ridge choice or checkpoint choice
split.trial_flags: Official unshifted trial starts; causal25tap history reset per trial/file
split.label_cost: All eligible support labels, actual counts and nominal seconds recorded; replay adds computation and repeated supervised exposure, not new labels

initializations.source_selection: Exact immutable L5 selected checkpoints; no reselection from H1 outcomes
initializations.pairing: Identical cyclic support-trial schedule and 150 attempted optimizer updates per initialization; deterministic Adam, no stochastic target reseeding

head.choice: At step0, choose once per initialization by mean three-fold support whole-trial LOO normalized SSE, ties smallest lambda; freeze chosen lambda throughout all filter updates and checkpoints
head.normalization: Each episode uses fitting-trial feature mean/std only, floor .1; unpenalized target mean, pooled target scale; final head fitted on all three support trials
head.inference: Float64 primal/dual ridge chosen by min(n,d); form weights before query product
head.frozen_comparison: Same initialization step0 at its support-selected lambda isolates adaptation from readout retuning; original L5 common-lambda1 results retained separately

target_training.encoder: Shared linear 5x25 causal per-neuron filter bank,125 parameters
target_training.episodes: At step t, hold out support trial t mod3, fit ridge on other two; normalize SSE on held-out trial using fitting-trial target scale
target_training.optimizer: Global backprop through ridge; Adam lr .001
target_training.limits: No local learning claim. All three support labels repeatedly influence meta-training; LOO objective is training objective, not independent validation.

selection.primary: Minimum mean three-fold support LOO normalized SSE at saved checkpoints including step0, ties earliest; no future query labels
selection.secondary: All fixed checkpoints including step150; do not replace primary based on future R2
selection.failure: Record attempted/successful/nonfinite updates; terminate failed fit, no replacement, no silent fallback or omitted failed initialization

references: All four frozen L5 full-history raw/sqrt ridge1/10 references
Both raw/sqrt full-history heads with same support-only LOO lambda grid, no trained filters
Original L5 common-lambda1 frozen scores (context only)
Each adapted initialization compared to its own step0 at same selected lambda

aggregation.point: Average three initialization scores within set for real/synthetic/time/random; V1 single score; then unweighted13-set mean, not prediction ensemble
aggregation.interval: Six recording-day cluster bootstrap, retain all sets per sampled day, weighted-by-set means,10000 draws rng20261011; descriptive one participant
contrasts: real adapted minus V1 adapted/random adapted/synthetic adapted/time adapted
real adapted minus its own frozen support-selected-lambda baseline
Each adapted method minus all fixed and support-selected capacity references
aggregation.selection_interpretation: Support-objective selection can overfit those three trials; only future-query scoring measures conditional generalization. No population significance or species conservation claim

preflight: Source-only stand-ins and finite-difference gradient through target objective
All per-initialization chosen lambdas/checkpoint selections reconstructed from support losses
Step0 exact equivalence to frozen pilot when lambda1 forced and own selected-lambda independent refits
Future query neural context independent of support trial spikes; no query labels in fit function
Immutable source/protocol hashes and prospective root execution record
artifacts: data/wacv/xspecies_l6_target_adapt: per-update/cp losses, all selected/raw predictions, states, support/query IDs and SHA, costs, failures, independent audit
execution: Claude owns implementation/CPU fits; root independently checks before human execution. GPU0 untouched.
novelty: Cross-species pretraining, neuronwise encoders and differentiable ridge already prior art; this compact attribution assay is not a first-transfer/model novelty claim.
